title: TRUNC ( -4.3 ) is -4: TRUNC removes the fractional part

source.quote: TRUNC(-4.3) returns -4, but INT(-4.3) returns -5 because -5 is the smaller number.

notes: The type is not asserted: Microsoft Learn says TRUNC returns a whole number, DAX Guide says a decimal value ("Other rounding functions (such as TRUNC) return a Decimal data type").
